Sitrin Capital Management LLC trimmed its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.1% in the 3rd quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund owned 46,272 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 526 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises 4.6% of Sitrin Capital Management LLC’s holdings, making the stock its largest position. Sitrin Capital Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $7,131,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.

Several analysts recently commented on AAPL shares. Mizuho set a $160.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “hold” rating in a report on Wednesday, October 18th. Vetr lowered Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $178.34 price objective on the stock. in a report on Friday, December 1st. Needham & Company LLC raised their price objective on Apple from $175.00 to $200.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Friday, November 3rd. Finally, Guggenheim reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $200.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, September 18th. One investment analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, nine have issued a hold rating, forty have assigned a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The company has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $198.94.
